sections.markdown:
## F — Communication and speed adjustment
Research index: knowledge and continuation facts are in C and C2 for Communication and speed adjustment. Each fact resolves to a single source page, with accepted identifiers preserved for downstream compilation.
VERIFY list:
- MT-sec10-COUNT: official question count unknown.
- MT-sec10-PASS: official passing standard unknown.
- MT-sec10-TIME: official time limit unknown.
- MT-sec10-EDITION: reconcile cover and back-cover revision statements.
- MT-sec10-HAND-SIGNALS: Physical page sixty-eight says drivers must know hand signals, but the illustrated mappings are absent from extraction. Obtain source-bound visual evidence before authoring them.
- MT-sec10-NIGHT-RANGE: Physical page seventy-three uses about four hundred feet of headlight range and about fifty miles per hour at night, while physical page twenty-four gives different high/low-beam ranges. Preserve general stop-within-view duty; reconcile the numerical nighttime illustration.
- MT-sec10-PASSING-SPEED: Physical page seventy-one says not to exceed the limit when passing, while the earlier rules chapter permits a specific two-lane excess. Exact current application must be reconciled before a blanket passing-speed rule is asserted.
- MT-sec10-TRACTION-ILLUSTRATIONS: Physical pages sixty-nine and seventy provide stopping-distance multipliers and approximate hydroplaning-speed examples without a full test-condition model. No guaranteed onset speed or universal stopping multiplier is asserted.
- MT-sec10-STATISTICS: Wildlife death/injury totals on page seventy-one and the human-judgment crash proportion on page seventy-three have no dated underlying study in this source. Those statistics are not asserted.
- MT-sec10-SAME-SPEED-ABSOLUTE: Page seventy-one says same-direction, same-speed vehicles cannot hit one another without describing lane-change geometry. That absolute claim is withheld pending clarification.
- MT-sec10-STUDDED-TIRES: Physical page seventy lists seasonal studded-tire dates and local restrictions; current applicable winter-tire law remains unverified and outside stable facts.
- MT-COMMUNICATION-MARKET: market evidence missing.
- MT-COMMUNICATION-TEARDOWN: competitor evidence missing.
Dynamic isolation: Posted limits, local rules and winter tire restrictions require current applicable controls; disputed numerical examples and the passing-speed conflict remain debt.
